div.p: Watch from the Afterspace movie library.

footer.span: Playback is provided by Google Drive. Cover metadata may be provided by TMDB and Apple Music.

section.button: Sign in to leave a review

div.p: Create a username and password to save your list, viewing history, ratings, and recommendations.

form.p: Use 3-20 letters, numbers, or underscores. Passwords need at least 6 characters.

div.p: Send a request. The other person must accept before you become friends.
This Noah account is authenticated, but it is still a member. In Firestore, create the collection roles, then create a document whose ID is:
Add a string field named role with the value owner. Then sign out and back in.

section.p: Owner, co-owner, and staff accounts can edit every catalog item and every item field. Changes are stored in Firebase and appear for everyone.

img.p: Paste a direct image URL. The image will be resized and saved inside Firebase as portable Base64 data.

div.p: Newest additions appear first. Select Feature to choose the large hero item for that section, or Edit to change any field.
